recipe.title: Assign available crews to simultaneous duties
recipe.scenario: Assign three overlapping duties to three prequalified crews. The eligibility list is supplied after checking fleet qualifications and availability; no crew can cover two overlapping duties. Prefer Crew Bravo for Duty 801 if every duty can be covered. This example does not calculate duty-time legality, rest, pairing, reserve recovery, or seniority.

field.name: duty-identifiers
field.description: Overlapping duties to be covered, in index order: Duty 801, Duty 816, Duty 842.

field.name: crew-identifiers
field.description: Candidate crew identifiers, in index order: Crew Alpha, Crew Bravo, Crew Charlie. Indices start at zero.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Consecutive zero-based duty and crew index pairs: 0,0; 0,1; 1,0; 1,2; 2,1; 2,2. These are the only eligible choices.

field.name: preferred-first-duty-crew
field.description: Crew index preferred for Duty 801 (index 1 is Crew Bravo). Omit this field for no preference; it cannot override eligibility or unique use.

field.name: assigned-crews
field.description: For a feasible plan: One crew index per duty, in duty order. With the example preference the result is [1,0,2].
